kpis.description_fr: Smoke-Free = IQOS (heat-not-burn) + ZYN (oral nicotine) + e-vapor. 38 % du CA total. Pivot stratégique. ZYN explose USA.
kpis.description_en: Smoke-Free = IQOS (heat-not-burn) + ZYN (oral nicotine) + e-vapor. 38% of total revenue. Strategic pivot. ZYN exploding in USA.

kpis.description_fr: 35,6 M utilisateurs IQOS adultes (heat-not-burn). Croissance soutenue Japon + Europe + maintenant USA (Q2 2024 launch). Leader catégorie.
kpis.description_en: 35.6M adult IQOS users (heat-not-burn). Sustained growth Japan + Europe + now USA (Q2 2024 launch). Category leader.

kpis.description_fr: ZYN nicotine pouches USA 580 M cans 2024 (+60 % yoy). Bestseller Gen Z + Millennials USA. Demand outstripping supply. Plus gros driver croissance PMI.
kpis.description_en: ZYN nicotine pouches USA 580M cans 2024 (+60% yoy). Gen Z + Millennial USA bestseller. Demand outstripping supply. PMI's biggest growth driver.

kpis.description_fr: Volume cigarettes traditionnelles ~620 Mds sticks. Décrue séculaire ~1-2 % /an. Pricing power compense largement (~5-7 % /an).
kpis.description_en: Traditional cigarette volume ~620B sticks. Secular decline ~1-2%/year. Pricing power amply compensates (~5-7%/year).

kpis.description_fr: 38 % du CA Smoke-Free (IQOS + ZYN + e-vapor). Cible 50 %+ horizon 2030. Transformation business model.
kpis.description_en: 38% of revenue from Smoke-Free (IQOS + ZYN + e-vapor). Target 50%+ by 2030. Business model transformation.
